build_debian_deps: build a step that installs Debian packages and configures the GCC version for the build environment
build_cmake_install: build and install a CMake-based project by configuring with defines then running make and make install
build_autoconf_install: build and install an autoconf-based project by running autoreconf, configure, make, and make install
build_github_project: build a Facebook GitHub project by cloning the repo, checking out a hash, and running cmake or autoconf
build_rust_toolchain: build a Rust project by enabling the Rust toolchain and running cargo build with parallelism
